task.description: Scope-creep/fidelity hard gate on ISS-0527's platform UAT corpus port and SECURITY-REVIEWER's applied fix.

result.note: Scope clean: git diff --stat main...HEAD shows exactly 18 new platform fixture files, 2 instruction docs, ISS-0527.yaml, and 3 handoff JSONs; zero touch on test/fixtures/simulation/, test/support/simulation/, the ISS-0526-ported swiftroute/vortex/meridian directories, or any .ex/.exs file. Byte-for-byte fidelity independently re-verified (own comparator, not trusted from ELIXIR-DEV's claim) for 10 of 18 files including both security-flagged ones, spread across pipeline_test:+NOTE / no-pipeline_test cases -- all byte-identical, correctly accounting for R-Co's own pre-existing 3-line comment below pipeline_test: which the port correctly preserves below the inserted NOTE, matching ISS-0526's own precedent. pipeline_test: count and annotation independently confirmed correct: exactly 12 real files carry it (not the issue's original ~7 estimate), all 12 carry NOTE (ISS-0527) never a stray ISS-0526 reference, the other 6 correctly carry neither field nor note. SECURITY-REVIEWER's applied fix (commit 1f48b630) confirmed accurate and correctly scoped: only 17 comment lines added above the --- divider, nothing below changed; its claims about router.ex's Deferred routes table and sandbox_pool.ex's actual unrelated scope verified against the real files. Instruction docs correct and accurate: uat-runner.md replaces deferred framing with the resolved path and accurate security-severity note; WF-05_uat_run.md names both paths. ISS-0527.yaml's append confirmed pure additive via git diff. No re-touch of test/fixtures/simulation/ or the ISS-0526-ported directories, no silent scope expansion, no re-decision of REQ-210's scoping -- exactly the follow-up ISS-0526 SS4 recommended. Real runs quoted: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted clean; mix test test/letflow/simulation/ 27 passed.
